description: InfraTableJoin ords 0/3/4/5: from-clause comma join of stream to keyed table, unkeyed table surviving module undeploy, unidirectional left outer join with null fill, and inner join with on-clause plus select * fragment access.

cases.observation: listener; comma join of SupportBean_S0 to keyed table varaggFC via where va.key=s0.p00; S0(0,'G1') yields value=100 after SupportBean(G1,100), S0(0,'G2') silent until SupportBean(G2,200) populates the key
